profile.headline: Senior Embedded Software Engineer | Canoo
profile.summary:
•	Master of Engineer in Electronics & Communication with 8+ years of experience as an Embedded Software Engineer. having a deep understanding of SDLC, programming languages, MCU and peripheral interfacing, IoT, and database. 
•	Experience in all phases of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) which involves requirement gathering, requirement analysis, design, development, implementation & enhancement of projects in Embedded Systems using Agile methodology.
•	Proficiency in driver development for various MCU like ARM Cortex-M4, PIC (16F877/18F877), Atmega328 and it's peripheral like GPIO, SPI, I2C, UART, ADC, DAC, Clock Management Unit, Watchdog Timer, RTC;
•	Hands-on experience in programming of WIFI module (ESP32, ESP8266), BLE module (Nordic nrf51), NFC (NXP tag 2), 
•	9-axis Motion Tracking (MPU 9150), GPS Module
•	Good knowledge of Embedded system debugging using Keil & IAR debugger, RS232, logic analyzers, Oscilloscope, etc.
•	Proficient in programming languages such as Embedded C, Python,  Ladder logic, and RTOS like FreeRTOS.
•	Expert in MATLAB scripting and its various toolbox like Image processing toolbox, Simulink, Deploy tool, etc.
•	Closely worked with programming tools such as IAR Embedded Workbench, Eclipse, Keil UV5, MPLAB.

positions.title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Embedded C · Embedded C++ · Embedded Linux · AUTOSAR · Yocto Project · Embedded Systems · Version Control · Coding Standards · Code Review · Python Scripting

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
Aerospace Industry
•	Design software architecture of aircraft bootloader for secure boot and update the engine control unit (ECU) software over CAN ARINC 825 Standard.
•	Developed source code targeting Microchip disPIC33 microcontroller.
•	Documented SRD and SDD as per DO-178C Standards.
•	Created test cases for on HW code coverage testing using  CTC++ utility and documented same as per DO-178C standards.

Automotive fuel pump industry
•	Wrote QPC framework-based architecture and designed interactive UI for controlling and monitoring CAM Rig system.
•	Wrote device drivers for multiple peripherals including I2C, UART, ADC, TIMER
•	Analyzed customer requirements and translated them into the design documents

Proof of Concept: A2B 
•	Stepped up as a lead engineer for the project.
•	Performed Design Analysis Resolution (DAR) matrix to select hardware components for the project.
•	Designed topology over sigma studio for transmitting and receiving audio simultaneously between two A2B nodes.
•	Ported A2B stack for the STM32 based platform.
positions.insights: Skills: Coding Standards · Version Control · Code Review · Peripherals

positions.title: Firmware Engineer
positions.description:
•	Performing tasks associated with analysis, design, and development of drivers (GPIO, SPI, I2C, UART) for MAX3263x and STM32F4xx based embedded systems (Tactilis Smartcard and Carrier).
•	Wrote ESP32 firmware to switch carrier into different communication mode between WIFI (WIFI AP + WIFI STATION) and Bluetooth. Program TCP socket in client and server mode to communicate with the carrier over WIFI and worked on file transfer commands to transfer the file to card memory.
•	Implemented low power mode for Wi-Fi and Target of Interest feature for BLE to save carrier power.
•	Secure communication by adding TLS (OpenSSL) on WIFI and pairing on BLE.
•    Programmed bootloader on STM32F4XX to update firmware at runtime. 
•	Added bootloader function to update carrier firmware over the air using Wi-Fi and BLE.
•	Introduced different state machine type to activate NFC based on the different authentication status of Tactilis smart card. And also programmed NXP NT2H1311 NFC tag to enable pass-through mode and enable communication between carrier and NFC reader.
•	Programmed different modes of GPS module to log current location and program MPU 9150 to log pedometer data. 
•	Worked on MQTT protocol to monitor as well as to change carrier settings with MQTT server.
•	Added mDNS and Static IP mode to identify carrier services through mDNS queries. 
•	Assisted to develop an android app to communicate with Smart Card Carrier to enroll verify and de-enroll fingerprint and file transfer function on Tactilis biometrics card.
•	R&D to add new features on biometrics authenticated smart card and its carrier related to AES security, user interface, and communication. 
•	Debugging and testing: Firmware bugs of the biometric smart card and its carrier.

positions.title: Embedded System Engineer
positions.description:
Description: OIC works on third-party projects and provides hardware as well as a software solution to the client.   
•	Performed tasks associated with analysis, design, and development of drivers (GPIO, SPI, I2C, UART) for STM32F4xx, PIC16F877, Atmega328 based embedded systems.
•	Actively involved in designing and building of home security system using STM32F407 Controller which is interfaced with the proximity sensor, gas sensor, temperature sensors (LM335) and GSM SIM900 module.
•	Interfaced capacitive touchpad with STM32F407 and worked extensively to provide a good Touch Experience.
•	Debugged and resolved: Software bugs - Logic Faults, Communication Protocol Faults, Unlikely behavior of a peripheral (code fault), Hard Faults - Resolving with tools like - Keil debugging options and writing test codes to check the failures, Logic Analyzers to check Communication Problems (I2C, SPI, UART).
•	Responsible for writing and executing test codes (ARM core) to check to work of different analog as well as digital sensors and motors.
•	Being a part of team assisted to develop an android app to control and monitor home or industrial appliances on Android Studio SDK 21.
•	R&D on Stereovision based 3D obstacle mapping for indoor/outdoor SLAM that involves feature point extraction of the object followed by matching and triangulation, which find optimum path & navigate the robot.
•	Implemented ladder logic to add resume capability and accurate control on solenoid valve on Delta DVP-14SS2 for bottle filling system.
•	Assisted in an IoT project for developing a prototype to switch electric appliances using the ESP8266 Wi-Fi module.
•	Basically, working on Embedded C, different MCU's, various interfacing protocols, learning new hardware and software based on the company's requirement. Working dynamically in a team towards completion of a product.

positions.title: Electronic Engineer
positions.description:
Description: It designs and manufacture rotary calcination plants as per the client specification and requirement.
•	Assisted to program PLC(1766-L32BXBA) and its monitoring on Wonderware Intouch(SCADA). Develop different alarm triggers for protection of manufacturing system and supply management.
